name: net.stabledomains/registrar
title: StableDomains
description: USDC/USDT domain registrar on 7 chains, card checkout for people, expiring drops, WHOIS/DNS tools.

tools.name: search_domains
tools.description: Check availability and USD price for a name across TLDs. Each result has premium (boolean; registry premium name) and renewal_price (USD/yr). If the name is taken, suggestions[] lists close AVAILABLE alternatives (live-checked, lowest price first).

tools.name: agent_signup
tools.description: Instant signup: returns an API key immediately (no form, no email). Guest tier (30 req/min) until claimed by email or wallet. Rate limited per IP (3/hour). Store the key; it is shown once. Pass it on later buying tools as api_key, or set Authorization: Bearer <key> on the MCP connection. Available on the full MCP server (/api/mcp). Not available on the read-only discover MCP (/api/mcp/discover).

tools.name: quote_domain
tools.description: Live price quote for one domain. Returns premium (boolean) and renewal_price (USD/yr). Premium orders are refused if they exceed what we can currently fund.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create a registration order (a price-locked quote). A 402 is the payment challenge, not an error: follow default_pay (usually gasless USDC on Base with x402), pay the existing invoice, and poll poll_url / check_order — do not create_order again for the same domain while status is awaiting_payment (repeats return the same order with reused:true). Returns quote{price_usd, locked_until}, pay{x402, transfer, checkout_url, poll_url}, payment requirements (exact amount_units — do not round to price_usd) and checkout_url. Policy: check availability right before buying, show the quote to the human and get confirmation before paying; pass idempotency_key (retries with the same key never create a second order; if omitted, identical calls within 15 min share a key, and any open unpaid register for the same buyer+domain is reused). pay_with=balance pays instantly from prepaid balance. Gasless: retry with x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE on this order pay URL, or POST /api/v1/register. Card: the 402 also carries card checkout fields; hand the human checkout_url. dry_run=true previews quote, renewal and blockers without creating an order.

chain.description: payment network (default base). hyperevm = HyperEVM (chain 999, USDC/USDT0), bsc = BNB Chain (56, 18-decimal USDC/USDT), tron = Tron TRC-20 (USDT only)

dry_run.description: preview only, nothing created or charged

ref.description: Affiliate ref code. Earn $0.60 per .com you refer, $0.51 per .xyz, paid weekly in USDC.

showcase.description: Opt in to the public /showcase listing (only if the user asked)

api_key.description: Optional. Guest or dashboard API key (sd_live_…). Prefer Authorization: Bearer <key> on the MCP connection; if your client cannot set headers, pass the key here.

tools.name: buy_with_balance
tools.description: Register a domain and pay from prepaid balance in one call.

api_key.description: Optional. Guest or dashboard API key (sd_live_…). Prefer Authorization: Bearer <key> on the MCP connection; if your client cannot set headers, pass the key here.

tools.name: check_order
tools.description: Get order status and next actions. If awaiting_payment, follow default_pay / pay_reminder (x402 USDC on Base, a transfer, or checkout_url for a human / card) and poll until paid or completed. Do not create another order.

tools.name: pay_order
tools.description: Submit payment for the existing unpaid invoice: tx_hash (EVM hash or Solana signature) of your transfer, or x_payment (base64 x402 EIP-3009 payload, gasless). Prefer default_pay from create_order / check_order. Then poll check_order. Do not create another order.

api_key.description: Optional. Guest or dashboard API key (sd_live_…). Prefer Authorization: Bearer <key> on the MCP connection; if your client cannot set headers, pass the key here.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get your prepaid USD balance and its ledger of top-ups and spends.

tools.name: topup_balance
tools.description: Create a top-up order (USD 1–5000); pay it like any order.

chain.description: payment network (default base). hyperevm = HyperEVM (chain 999, USDC/USDT0), bsc = BNB Chain (56, 18-decimal USDC/USDT), tron = Tron TRC-20 (USDT only)

api_key.description: Optional. Guest or dashboard API key (sd_live_…). Prefer Authorization: Bearer <key> on the MCP connection; if your client cannot set headers, pass the key here.

tools.name: find_dropping_domains
tools.description: Find expiring, pending-delete and just-dropped domains ranked by a verified quality score (0-100) built from sampled Wayback snapshots (real site vs parked/for-sale), Common Crawl presence, dictionary/brandability and spam heuristics; Majestic referring subnets only count when the archive shows a real site. Parked and spam names are hidden by default; each item includes quality_reasons. Free tier returns top 25; status=available names can be bought immediately with create_order. For presets, estimated value, multi-TLD and keyword filters use drop_radar.

show_parked.description: include names whose archive shows only parked/for-sale pages (hidden by default)

order.description: sort direction; default depends on sort

drops_within_days.description: pending-delete names dropping within N days

tools.name: drop_radar
tools.description: Domain Drop Radar: expiring, pending-delete and just-dropped domains filtered by TLD(s), length, keywords, value, quality and drop date, with presets (short-brandable, ai-names, dictionary-com, real-history, cheap-good, dropping-this-week). Returns a summary plus the top 25 with quality reasons, est. value, price, and a ready create_order body for available names or a watch body for others. For up to 500 rows call GET /api/v1/drops/full via x402 ($0.01). Page with limit + cursor (next_cursor in the response); sort with sort + order. To be alerted on future matches call radar_alert.

order.description: sort direction; default depends on sort

drops_within_days.description: pending-delete names dropping within N days

tools.name: radar_alert
tools.description: Save a Drop Radar search and get a signed webhook (event radar.match, header X-StableDomains-Signature = sha256 HMAC of the body with the returned secret) and/or email (double opt-in) when new names match or a pending-delete name drops. Free: 3 alerts per IP, 25 with an API key, max 20 events per alert per day. filters takes the same fields as drop_radar.

filters.description: same fields as drop_radar (preset, tlds, keywords, max_len, min_quality, ...)

tools.name: suggest_domains
tools.description: Free. Pass domain (e.g. a taken name like agent.com) to get close AVAILABLE alternatives (other extensions, get/try/hq/app variants), live-checked and ranked by price. Or pass idea to generate brandable names for a product idea. Returns only names available right now with USD price and checkout_url.

domain.description: a (taken) domain to find alternatives for

idea.description: plain-words idea, e.g. ai bookkeeping for plumbers

tools.name: estimate_domain_value
tools.description: Heuristic USD value estimate for any domain (length, TLD, dictionary words, brandability, Wayback age, backlinks) with factor breakdown and availability.

tools.name: whois_lookup
tools.description: RDAP (modern WHOIS) lookup for any domain: registrar, created/expires dates, status codes, nameservers, DNSSEC.

tools.name: domain_report
tools.description: Full public-data report for any domain: registrar, dates, status codes in plain English, DNS, website and hosting, HTTPS certificate, email (SPF/DMARC/DKIM/MTA-STS/TLS-RPT/BIMI), subdomains, transfer readiness, and our register/transfer/renewal prices when we sell that ending.

tools.name: dns_email_check
tools.description: DNS + email security audit via DNS-over-HTTPS: A/AAAA/MX/NS/CAA, SPF, DKIM (common or given selectors), DMARC policy, grade A-F and concrete fixes.

tools.name: is_domain_dropping
tools.description: Is an expired domain about to become available? Returns lifecycle (grace, redemption, pending delete, available, registered), estimated drop date and backlink data if in our drop feed.

tools.name: domain_history
tools.description: Internet Archive history for a domain or page URL: earliest and latest snapshots (with view links), snapshot/month counts, unique pages, years active, status-code mix, yearly timeline, and a short former-use title check (casino/adult/pharma/loan flags). Read-only. Free.

domain.description: domain or page URL, e.g. example.com

tools.name: watch_domain
tools.description: Get notified when an expiring domain changes status or drops (becomes registrable). Pass webhook_url (active immediately, POSTs JSON events domain.status_changed / domain.available with a ready order_api body) and/or email (double opt-in). Free.

tools.name: set_url_forward
tools.description: FREE 301 URL forwarding for a domain you registered with us: forward the whole domain (subdomain '@', also covers www) or a subdomain to any https URL. Points DNS at our redirect service. preserve_path keeps /path?query.

tools.name: list_url_forwards
tools.description: URL forwards configured on a domain you own.

tools.name: apply_dns_template
tools.description: FREE one-call DNS setup for a domain you own. template: vercel | netlify (params.site) | github-pages (params.user) | google-workspace | microsoft-365 | zoho-mail (params.region: com|eu|in|com.au). Replaces only the conflicting web or MX/SPF records.

tools.name: get_dns
tools.description: Nameservers and DNS records (A/AAAA/CNAME/MX/TXT) of a domain you own.

tools.name: get_ssl
tools.description: Status and, when issued, the free wildcard SSL certificate (fullchain, cert, chain and private key PEMs) for a domain you own. Requires default nameservers.

tools.name: set_dns
tools.description: Set DNS records and/or nameservers of a domain you own. records: [{type: A|AAAA|CNAME|MX|TXT|NS (SRV/CAA/ALIAS not supported on hosted DNS: use custom nameservers), name: '@'|sub, value, ttl?, priority? (MX)}]. mode 'replace' (default) replaces the FULL record set; mode 'merge' adds/updates the given records, deletes any in remove [{type,name,value?}], and keeps everything else (safer for adding MX/TXT next to a website).

tools.name: issue_ssl
tools.description: Issue or renew a free wildcard SSL certificate (the domain and *.domain) for a domain you own on default nameservers. Returns pending while DNS propagates; call again with poll:true (or get_ssl) to finish. action renew forces renewal.

tools.name: renew_domain
tools.description: Renew a domain you own. Returns USDC payment requirements (402), or pay_with=balance to renew instantly from prepaid balance. dry_run=true previews quote, new expiry and blockers without charging.

tools.name: set_notification_webhook
tools.description: Signed account webhook (returns secret). Events: domain.registered, domain.registration_pending, domain.registration_completed, domain.transfer_started, domain.transfer_completed, domain.renewed, domain.expiring, dns.changed. Verify X-StableDomains-Signature = sha256 HMAC of the raw body with the secret; retries for 24h, dedupe on X-StableDomains-Delivery. null to remove.

tools.name: get_referral_link
tools.description: Referral link for a code (?ref=<code>, 30-day first-referrer attribution). This tool is read-only. Pass code for a known public referral code — no auth needed; the link is deterministic. Omit code and sign in (or send an API key) to get or create your own code — no payout address required to activate; earnings accrue until you set one. Earn $0.60 per .com you refer, $0.51 per .xyz, paid weekly in USDC. Programme terms: https://stabledomains.net/affiliates.json. Available on the full MCP and the read-only discover MCP (/api/mcp/discover).

code.description: Existing public referral code. Required when you are not signed in.

tools.name: get_referral_stats
tools.description: Referral stats (read-only). Pass code for public aggregate-safe counts on a known code (clicks, sales, referred users; no payout address or earnings ledger) — no auth needed. Omit code and sign in (or send an API key) for your own full dashboard including earnings and payouts. Stats follow the account and API key that own the widget or referral code — use that owner key, not a guest/secondary key. Programme terms: https://stabledomains.net/affiliates.json. Available on the full MCP and the read-only discover MCP (/api/mcp/discover).

code.description: Existing public referral code. Required when you are not signed in; returns public counts only.

tools.name: set_payout_address
tools.description: Set the Base USDC address that receives your weekly referral payouts (null to clear). Optional to activate — get_referral_link works first; earnings accrue until an address is set. Crypto-only programme (USDC on Base). Affiliate setup only — not a purchase. Available on the full MCP server (/api/mcp). Not available on the read-only discover MCP (/api/mcp/discover).

tools.name: set_auto_renew
tools.description: Turn auto-renew on/off for a domain you own and/or fund its renewal balance (vault). deposit_usd moves USDC from your prepaid balance (topup_balance) into the domain's vault; withdraw_usd moves it back. The daily job renews 1 year when ≤30 days from expiry if the vault covers the price, otherwise emails reminders at 30/14/7/1 days.

api_key.description: Optional. Guest or dashboard API key (sd_live_…). Prefer Authorization: Bearer <key> on the MCP connection; if your client cannot set headers, pass the key here.

tools.name: get_renewal_balance
tools.description: Auto-renew vault for a domain: renewal balance, 1-year renewal price, whether it is covered, shortfall, days to expiry and ledger. Omit domain to list all your domains' renewal balances.

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search the StableDomains.net agent directory (approved AI agents and MCP servers) by keyword or capability. Returns name, description, url, endpoint_url, mcp_url, capabilities, payment_methods and profile_url.

tools.name: list_my_agent
tools.description: Agent profiles you submitted (any status: pending, approved, rejected) with review notes. Submit a new one with POST /api/v1/agents (auth required, moderated).

tools.name: list_domains

tools.name: contact_support
tools.description: Open a support ticket with a person at StableDomains (order, payment, DNS, transfer, account or abuse issues). Pass the order_id or its SD- ref if there is one. A person replies by email to the given address; the response is a ticket ref (T-XXXXXX). Do not include secrets, API keys or wallet keys in the message.
